general: With debtors you keep a grip on your outstanding receivables and master data. Debtors form the basis of your sales process — no system can work without this source. A correct conversion yields debtor data that has a direct impact on your structure and invoice flow.
Below, the import template for debtors is described at field level. Follow the filling rules precisely to guarantee an error-free import into AFAS Profit.
Example data and frequently asked questions are also included, to make filling in the import template as easy as possible.

Debiteur Nummer.description: The unique debtor number from the source system. It is carried over into AFAS Profit and serves as the key for the debtor. Each number may appear only once in the file.

Organisatie of Persoon.description: Determines whether the debtor is an organisation (O) or a natural person (P). With O, Organisatie Naam is required. With P, Voorletters, Voornaam and Achternaam are required.

Organisatie Naam.description: The full company name including legal form (B.V., N.V., etc.), as registered with the Chamber of Commerce. It is shown on invoices, payment reminders and correspondence. Maximum 100 characters. Required when Organisatie of Persoon = O. The name is compared with the debtors already in AFAS (live): if the same organisation is there under a different debtor number, delete the line or change the debtor number in AFAS. If the debtor number in AFAS already has a different name, Debiteur Nummer will receive an error.

Voorletters.description: The initials of the person, including full stop. Format: X.X. — capital letters only, each followed by a full stop. Required when Organisatie of Persoon = P.

Voornaam.description: The first name of the person. Required when Organisatie of Persoon = P.

Voorvoegsel.description: The name prefix of the surname, in lowercase and without the surname itself. Leave empty when the person has no name prefix or when the debtor is an organisation.

Achternaam.description: The surname of the person, without name prefix. Required when Organisatie of Persoon = P.

Verzamelrekening.description: The general ledger account in which this debtor is collected financially. Required: there is no default, so fill it in for every debtor (usually 1400). Checked against the collective accounts in the AFAS environment of this project.

KvK-nummer.description: The Chamber of Commerce (KvK) number of the organisation, if known. Always 8 digits, without spaces or hyphens.

BTW Nummer.description: The VAT identification number, if known, in the official format per country. Dutch format: NL + 9 digits + B + 2 digits.

Automatisch Incasseren.description: Indicates whether outstanding invoices are automatically collected by SEPA direct debit from the IBAN given. With J the IBAN-Nummer column is required.

Betalingsvoorwaarde.description: The code of the payment condition that determines the standard payment term, checked against the payment condition table in AFAS. Available: the day codes 8, 14, 21, 30, 45, 60, 90 and 120 (number of days after invoice date), cont (cash) and Inc. (automatic direct debit). Note: this is the code, not the number of days — the two are not always the same.

BTW Plicht.description: The VAT category of the debtor (codes from the Hulptabel). Leave empty when the standard settings apply. 1 = Sales standard, 2 = Reverse charge (Verlegd naar), 3 = Sales within EU, 4 = Import/export outside EU, 5 = Distance selling, 6 = No VAT (intercompany), 7 = Margin scheme, 8 = Exempt.

Aanmanen.description: Indicates whether a payment reminder is sent automatically when a payment is overdue.

IBAN-Nummer.description: The International Bank Account Number of the debtor, without spaces. Required when Automatisch Incasseren is J; leave empty when N.

Land van Bank.description: The AFAS country code of the country where the bank is established, checked against the country list in AFAS. Note: this is not the ISO code — Belgium is B, Germany D. Required when IBAN-Nummer is filled in.

Email.description: The general e-mail address of the organisation, in the format name@domain.extension. One address per field.

Telefoon werk.description: The general telephone number of the organisation, without spaces or hyphens. International numbers may include the country code (e.g. +31201234567).

Email Fin Adm.description: The e-mail address of the financial administration, for payment reminders, invoices and other financial correspondence. It is checked for a valid e-mail address, but in this conversion it is not sent to AFAS: the debtor has no separate field for it.

Straatnaam.description: The street name of the business address, without house number.

Huisnummer.description: The numeric house number of the business address. Any addition goes in 'Toevoeging Huisnummer'. If the addition is included (17-19, 12 A), the tool splits the number itself: 17 stays here, -19 goes to 'Toevoeging Huisnummer', in front of what is already there (250- with addition 252 becomes 250 and -252).

Toevoeging Huisnummer.description: The addition to the house number (letter, floor or unit designation). Leave empty when no addition applies.

Postcode.description: The postcode of the business address, in the notation of the relevant country. With Land NL the tool checks the spelling: 4 digits and 2 letters, e.g. 1013 BG. A foreign postcode is not checked for format.

Woonplaats.description: The official place name of the business address, checked against the town/city list in AFAS for the country in the Land column (no country filled in = NL). Use the official spelling: 's-Gravenhage, not Den Haag. Only Dutch places are on that list; with a foreign country the place is not checked.

Land.description: The AFAS country code of the business country, checked against the country list in AFAS. Required: AFAS needs a country for every address, including a Dutch address — then enter NL. Note: this is not the ISO code — Belgium is B, Germany D, Afghanistan AFG.

faq.question: The numbering falls outside the range.
faq.answer: The debtor number uses a number that does not exist within the number range set up in AFAS. Check the number and try again.

faq.question: No valid town/city can be found for the postcode.
faq.answer: AFAS has found an incorrect combination of town/city and postcode. Adjust the town/city table or the conversion file.

faq.question: Can I also enter the debtors into AFAS manually?
faq.answer: With a conversion, people automatically think of 'importing', but a conversion can also be done manually via registration. Building an import and validating the data also takes time — together you can weigh which is more efficient. Manual entry also contributes to training and system experience. You make this choice together.

faq.question: An Excel file is so much work to fill in. Can this wait until a later moment?
faq.answer: Experience shows that 'filling in a list' is always underestimated and takes much more time than expected. That creates time pressure and leads to substantive errors, which require corrections and create more work. Discuss this with your consultant in good time.

faq.question: Do all debtors really need an address?
faq.answer: Yes. Debtors need a complete address according to Dutch addressing: street, house number, postcode and town/city.

faq.question: Are the outstanding invoices also needed?
faq.answer: No. The outstanding invoices are handled through a separate conversion. This conversion focuses on the master data of the debtors.
